title: Omprakash v. State of U.P. and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Syed Qamar Hasan Rizvi, JJ.
disposition: Disposed after withdrawal of the theft demand notice.
headnote: A writ against a demand notice for Rs.1,36,294 towards electricity charges in an alleged theft case was disposed of after the Electricity Department withdrew the notice. The Department was left at liberty to pass a fresh order after hearing the petitioner, strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed in the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Omprakash petitioned the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and two others to challenge a demand notice dated 11 November 2020. The notice called for Rs.1,36,294 as electricity charges in a case of alleged theft of electricity. Before the Court, counsel for the Electricity Department stated that the notice had been withdrawn and that the Department would pass a fresh order after giving the petitioner a hearing.

holding_units.topic: fresh order after withdrawal of a theft demand
holding_units.holding: Where the Electricity Department withdraws a demand notice for electricity charges in a theft case, the writ challenging that notice is disposed of without a decision on liability. The Department has liberty to pass a fresh order only after affording the consumer a hearing, and that order must be strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed in the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: The order names the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 and no clause number. Catalog hit JH-2005::9.2 is another State's code and is not applied.

principle_tags.application: After the Department withdrew the theft demand, the writ was disposed of with liberty to pass a fresh order only after a hearing and strictly in accordance with the procedure in the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner was liable for theft of electricity and for the sum of Rs.1,36,294 demanded by the notice dated 11.11.2020.
not_decided.note: The impugned notice was withdrawn. Any fresh order was left to a hearing and the procedure in the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
